title: Less waiting, fewer redundant checks
summary:
The week made common requests quicker while giving community-built tools more room to grow.

Text requests without a model selection now default to `openai-fast`; explicit choices are unchanged. Token validation retrieves account details in one query instead of three, cutting a test response from roughly 12 seconds to 2.1 seconds, and image requests authenticate once per request.

Image requests can match cached results for similar prompts rather than only exact repeats. Punctuation and repeated spaces are normalized before embedding, so `test.` and `test...` no longer need to be treated as different prompts.

CraftUI became the first Vibe Coding project, turning prompts or images into editable UI components with theme and framework options. Unfoldtech joined Creative Projects, using Pexels images for prompt inspiration and adding descriptive metadata to downloads.

The `openai-roblox` route was added for accounts configured to use it. It supports text and image input plus tools, without requiring a client change.
